abstract: Maintains batch fill yield metrics and automated inspection performance data
system_message:
You are the Fill-finish process engineering lead (ENG), responsible for maintaining batch fill yield metrics, automated optical inspection performance data, and related engineering records for CDMO candidates evaluated for the sterile fill-finish manufacturing partnership.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains batch fill yield metrics and automated inspection performance data（PROC）
information_points.content:
ENG-PROC-52W：For Vanguard BioPharma Solutions, production batch record reconciliation across five consecutive demonstration fill-finish runs indicates a batch fill yield of 98 % for dispensed bulk drug product successfully vialed and stoppered within specification. According to line cycle time studies for a standard 50,000-vial commercial production lot, the primary inspection duration required for 100 % automated optical inspection and manual re-inspection is 20 h.
ENG-PROC-3FV：For Apex Sterile Biologics, production batch record reconciliation across five consecutive demonstration fill-finish runs demonstrates a batch fill yield of 96 %, representing the percentage of dispensed bulk drug product successfully vialed and stoppered within specification. Additionally, line cycle time studies for a standard 50,000-vial commercial production lot reflect a primary inspection duration of 16 h to complete 100 % high-speed automated optical inspection and manual re-inspection.
ENG-PROC-SH9：For Meridian Fill-Finish Partners, production batch record reconciliation across five consecutive demonstration fill-finish runs shows a batch fill yield of 93 % of dispensed bulk drug product successfully vialed and stoppered within specification. Furthermore, line cycle time data for a standard 50,000-vial commercial production lot indicates a primary inspection duration of 16 h to finish 100 % high-speed automated optical inspection and manual re-inspection.

information_points.title: Nitrogen purge control（PURG）
information_points.content:
ENG-PURG-EI9：Telemetry logs from the headspace analyzer for sealed vials tested immediately after stoppering record a residual headspace oxygen concentration of 0.8 % for Apex Sterile Biologics.
ENG-PURG-XPS：Headspace analyzer telemetry logs for sealed vials tested immediately following stoppering show a residual headspace oxygen concentration of 0.4 % for Vanguard BioPharma Solutions.
ENG-PURG-WBN：According to headspace analyzer telemetry logs evaluated immediately post-stoppering, Meridian Fill-Finish Partners demonstrates a residual headspace oxygen concentration of 1.2 % inside sealed vial headspaces.
